messages:
emma_support: Heads-up — Novalabs (acct team) just pinged: wire for invoice INV-9987 was returned by the beneficiary bank. Bank message: \"ACCOUNT CANNOT BE CREDITED — BIC/SWIFT NOT RECOGNISED\". Return code from our bank: RTN-GB-BIC-01. Payment ID: pay_20260304_9a8b7c. Customer says they used the BIC their finance team always uses. :grimacing:

josh_payments: Can you paste the sanitized beneficiary details (IBAN/BIC) and the exact return text from the intermediary/correspondent? We need to confirm whether it's a format vs. stale BIC change.

emma_support: Copying what the customer submitted (sanitized):
Beneficiary name: Nova Labs Inc.
IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
BIC provided: NWBKGB2LXXX
Bank return note: \"Receiver BIC not registered in SWIFT directory\"
Attached screenshot of bank return (customer redacted acct numbers). Reaction :eyes:

payments-bot: Automated lookup: BIC NWBKGB2LXXX => found (legacy), preferred 8-char BIC: NWBKGB2L. Some banks reject 11-char with XXX if they require branch-specific BIC.

maya_bankops: Looks like a BIC mismatch / formatting issue rather than IBAN checksum. Quick checks:
- NWBKGB2LXXX maps to NatWest Bank PLC (legacy) 
- Some non-UK correspondent banks expect 8-char BICs or an explicit intermediary.
- If the beneficiary bank moved to a new BIC post-2022, returns like this can happen.

Repro steps for ops:
1) Fetch payment details: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/payments/pay_20260304_9a8b7c
```
2) Confirm outbound wire payload (BIC field) in the sent message.
3) Query SWIFT directory / correspondent logs to confirm if receiving bank accepts 11-char BIC.

josh_payments: For immediate unblock — propose two options, ask customer which they prefer: 
A) Re-issue wire with 8-char BIC NWBKGB2L (drop XXX) and include intermediary bank details (we recommend CHASGB2L for GBP clearing)
B) Re-initiate using our ACH-to-GBP partner rails (slower) to avoid BIC issues.

emma_support: Customer replied: they prefer we re-send same-day with corrected BIC; they confirmed intermediary bank info. They asked for a short note we can send to their treasury team to avoid future rejects.

maya_bankops: I'm going to re-submit the wire from the dedicated payments pool with BIC NWBKGB2L and intermediary CHASGB2L as follows. I'll also set a special tag on the payment so our monitoring alerts if the receiving bank returns again.

payments-bot: Action recorded — resubmit request queued by maya_bankops (ticket: PAYOPS-7721). ETA for processing: ~15 minutes.

emma_support: Customer updated: thank you — they got a confirmation from their bank that funds were credited. Customer noted invoice marked PAID in their AP system. :tada:

josh_payments: Postmortem notes / follow-ups:
- Add client-side BIC validation to billing portal (warn on 11-char vs 8-char difference and suggest both forms).
- Add a small help text explaining when to include an intermediary/correspondent bank for cross-border GBP wires.
- Add logging to capture returned SWIFT codes to a structured field so we can auto-suggest fixes in support UI.

emma_support: I'll send a brief template to the customer summarizing what happened and what we changed. Closing the thread once PAYOPS-7721 is resolved.

maya_bankops: PAYOPS-7721 -> resolved at 1801234680. Bank accepted on re-submit. Closing from ops side. 

emma_support: Resolved. Customer emailed confirmation and asked us to record preferred BIC as NWBKGB2L in their billing profile. Will update profile and add a one-off validation rule. :white_check_mark:
